messages:
ara.partners: FYI launching CloudForge marketplace + HW next Wed. we need a lean partner SEV flow so we don't end up with two warrooms. goal: one channel, one bridge, clear ack SLAs.
mike.sre: short flow idea: vendor webhook -> creates #partner-sev-{partner}-{env} -> auto-bridge -> assign primary/backup. keep triage SLA targets: support ack 10m, eng triage 20m for sev1.
tay.support: +1. also add a one-line first post template so partner includes essential fields: external-id, env, symptom, hw-serials(if any), impact. cuts ping-pong.
luca.integration: note: vendor portals sometimes send duplicate alerts (email + webhook). rule: de-dupe on external-id; attach duplicates to same channel. if no external-id, create one and update both sides.
mike.sre: fallback: if partner can't join bridge within 8m, partnership rep creates 3-way call and posts link. ops-bot will post oncall roster automatically.
ops-bot: automation: when channel topic contains "partner-sev" bot runs `/bridge create --ttl 6h` and posts link.
ara.partners: i'll draft the one-pager and schedule a 20m dry-run 48h before launch. thanks everyone.
